verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway API, so a sandbox or test environment separate from production is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. Per-key spend caps, service accounts, and load-balancing A/B testing are adjacent controls, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
